title: Jump keys: Ctrl-Cmd-1..9 focus panes in reading order (9 is the last); Ctrl-Cmd-E focuses the sidebar, showing it when hidden; Up and Down there switch workspaces
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal pane with keyboard focus
converted from scripts/cmux-next/jump-keys-e2e.py, which stays; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-094.json links them

steps.note: Split Right: a second terminal pane, focused
a third pane: the screen reads pane 1, 2, 3 left to right, and pane 3 has focus
Focus Pane 1 (focusPaneByNumber): the first pane in reading order
script row 'Ctrl-Cmd-9 focuses the last pane': from pane 1, so the wait sees the move to pane 3
script row 'Pane 1 then Next Pane is pane 2': the numbers follow Next Pane's reading order

expect.noReceiptReason: Focus Pane 5 with three panes has no pane to focus; the key may run the action as a quiet no-op or pass through, and either way focus stays

steps.note: script row 'Ctrl-Cmd-5 with three panes keeps focus' on pane 2

a second workspace, shown, below the first, as the script makes it: Cmd-N follows workspaces.newPlacement, which defaults to top (schemas/defaults/cmux-next.json), and would put it above the launch workspace
script row 'Ctrl-Cmd-E puts the keyboard in the sidebar'

expect.noReceiptReason: an arrow key in the workspace list moves its selection; the list handles it, not a key-router action

steps.note: Up selects and shows the first workspace

expect.noReceiptReason: an arrow key in the workspace list moves its selection; the list handles it, not a key-router action

steps.note: Down goes back to the second workspace
script row 'Ctrl-Cmd-E shows a hidden sidebar and focuses it'

invariants: the focused panes at pane-1, pane-2 and pane-3 are the three distinct panes of three-panes, in the layout's left-to-right order
the focused pane at pane-9 equals the one at pane-3: 9 is the last pane, whatever the count
the focused pane at next-pane equals the one at pane-2: pane numbers follow Next Pane's reading order
the focused pane at pane-5 equals the one at next-pane: a number past the last pane leaves focus where it is
focus/windows/0/responder is sidebar at focus-sidebar and at sidebar-shown
the focused workspace at sidebar-up is the launch workspace and at sidebar-down the one new-workspace made
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: hint mode's Shift on a label's last letter right-clicks its control (Cmd-J F): hint labels are chosen per run and no facet lists them, so a case cannot type one; it also needs labs.previewFeatures
the script's window image of the hint menu (debug.window_snapshot)
